title: Customer Insights - Journeys: Journey Creation Agent builds journeys from a plain-language description
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, administrator enablement, licensing, prerequisites and journey behaviour are supported. Minor corrections should extend two control paths and name the request-body properties for credit allocation; both API calls flagged by the pre-check are documented.

claims.claim: The credit allocation and tenant draw row gives Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Allocate capacity.
claims.quote: Under Allocate capacity, enter the number of Copilot Credits to allocate to the environment. ... Under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant
claims.fix: Keep the allocation route, and append in controls[2].note: 'On the same pane, under Capacity overages, select or clear Draw from the available capacity in my tenant.' The row currently reaches the allocation control but omits the tenant-draw control documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/programmability-tutorial-manage-copilot-credit-allocations.

claims.where: controls[2].api; Governance controls; rendered controls table
claims.claim: PUT /licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 updates environment credit allocation and tenant capacity draw.
claims.quote: $apiVersion = "2024-10-01" ... Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put ... -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" ... @{ ruleType = "TenantPool"; enabled = $false }
claims.fix: Append to controls[2].note: 'The request body identifies scope.environmentId, sets allocatedEntitlements[].entitlementId to MCSMessages and allocation.quantity to the credit allocation, and uses enforcementRules[] with ruleType TenantPool and enabled to control tenant capacity draw.' These fields are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/programmability-tutorial-manage-copilot-credit-allocations; retain the existing method and path.
